title: Claude Fable 5.2 review: fast, creative, and finally not annoying
author: Claire Vo
description: Watch now (25 mins) | 🎙️ My first-look at Fable 5.2: what it built for me, where it fell down, and whether it belongs in your daily AI stack
summary: Anthropic just released Fable 5.2, their new frontier model, and I spent two days actually building things with it before recording this. I made an animated marketing video from a single tweet, assembled a pile of unboxed furniture using only blurry floor photos, and extended our CXO brand sprites into a full bug-defense game complete with a trailer.
takeaways: I made an animated marketing video from a single tweet, assembled a pile of unboxed furniture using only blurry floor photos, and extended our CXO brand sprites into a full bug-defense game complete with a trailer.
In this episode I walk through what impressed me, what fell short, and how I’m thinking about routing tasks between Fable 5.2 and Opus 5.5 going forward.
